name: Septuagint, deuterocanonical books (Swete, via LXX-Swete-1930)
attribution: Greek text of H. B. Swete's The Old Testament in Greek according to the Septuagint (Cambridge, 1907-1912; public domain), digitised by Pasquale Amicarelli and published by Eliran Wong in LXX-Swete-1930 (https://github.com/eliranwong/LXX-Swete-1930) under the GNU General Public License v3. Modified for Lectio: deuterocanonical books and Greek Esther and Daniel only, split into words, text-critical signs and bracketed verse numbers removed, Greek Esther additions stored as chapters A-F, the Letter of Jeremiah as Baruch 6, Susanna and Bel as Daniel 13 and 14, Sirach 30-36 in the Latin chapter order, Daniel 3:98-6:28 renumbered and the verses re-divided where they shift against the lxx scheme.
